title: B cell TET2 recruits OGT for nuclear TET2 and H2B O-GlcNAcylation to drive AID and BLIMP-1 expression and maturation of the antibody response.
authors: Li, Shili; Peng, Yibo; Yang, Zhimin; Li, Xin; Xu, Zhenming; Rivera, Carlos E; Casali, Paolo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究B细胞中TET2招募OGT介导DNA去甲基化与组蛋白修饰以调控抗体成熟相关基因表达，虽涉及TET2-DNA互作与AlphaFold复合物建模，但核心是表观遗传调控而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法上仅用AlphaFold建模，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Maturation of antibody responses entails B cell Aicda/AID and Prdm1/BLIMP-1 expression for SHM/CSR, plasma cell differentiation, and production of class-switched high-affinity antibodies. We determined that TET1, TET2, and TET3 are not expressed in resting naive B lymphocytes, and only TET2 is induced in differentiating B cells for AID and BLIMP-1 expression. B cell TET2 recruits OGT, a metabolic sensor and sole protein O-GlcNAcylator, for O-GlcNAcylation of itself and chromatin H2B-S112. TET2 O-GlcNAcylation supports TET2-mediated active DNA demethylation (5mC oxidation to 5hmC) of Aicda and Prdm1 loci. This, together with these loci H2B-S112 O-GlcNAcylation, promotes Aicda/AID and Prdm1/BLIMP-1 expression for maturation of T-dependent and T-independent antibody responses. TET2 recruits OGT through its C-terminal-end, as evidenced by Tet2(OGT-Deltamut) C-terminal-end deletion mutant and AlphaFold 3.0-modeled TET2-DNA-OGT complex. Finally, B cell TET2 takes metabolic cues for Aicda/AID and Prdm1/BLIMP-1 expression, as shown by fumarate inhibition and vitamin C activation of TET2 in humanized THX mice and Tcrbeta(-/-)Tcrdelta(-/-) mice.
abstract_zh: 抗体反应的成熟涉及B细胞中Aicda/AID和Prdm1/BLIMP-1的表达，以进行SHM/CSR、浆细胞分化以及类别转换的高亲和力抗体的产生。我们确定TET1、TET2和TET3在静息初始B淋巴细胞中不表达，仅在分化中的B细胞中诱导TET2表达，以支持AID和BLIMP-1的表达。B细胞中的TET2招募OGT（一种代谢传感器和唯一的蛋白质O-GlcNAc修饰酶），对自身及染色质H2B-S112进行O-GlcNAc修饰。TET2的O-GlcNAc修饰支持TET2介导的Aicda和Prdm1位点的活性DNA去甲基化（5mC氧化为5hmC）。这与这些位点的H2B-S112 O-GlcNAc修饰共同促进Aicda/AID和Prdm1/BLIMP-1的表达，从而驱动T依赖性和T非依赖性抗体反应的成熟。TET2通过其C末端招募OGT，这由Tet2(OGT-Deltamut) C末端缺失突变体和AlphaFold 3.0模拟的TET2-DNA-OGT复合物所证实。最后，B细胞中的TET2接收代谢信号以调节Aicda/AID和Prdm1/BLIMP-1的表达，这通过人源化THX小鼠和Tcrbeta(-/-)Tcrdelta(-/-)小鼠中富马酸对TET2的抑制及维生素C对TET2的激活得以证明。
